editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The permissions table, the four-policy walkthrough and the caveats ("Only if role is set up for all resources", the invite-first note) are all kept intact. One real slip: in [4], the italicised term being defined, "service instance", is rendered "contoh perkhidmatan" ("contoh" means "example"). Everywhere else the file correctly uses "instans perkhidmatan", including [38] and the table. Smaller points: the IAM role "Viewer" becomes "Penonton" (spectator/audience), which is recognisable but odd; "pra-takrifkan" is a non-standard form of "pratakrif" / "yang dipratakrifkan"; and the console button labels (Assign, Add, Create) are translated, so a learner using the English IBM Cloud console may not find the matching buttons.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout: the layout_mode options, the replace_only_if_better default, the thread defaults and the subgraph caveat are all intact. The main problem is that "pass" is rendered two ways. The headings and the keep/improve entries leave "transpiler passes" in English ([0], [1], [13], [14]), while the rest of the file uses "laluan transpiler". In [23], "sehingga enam blok qubit" puts the number on the blocks, so it reads as "up to six blocks". Entries [20] and [21] correctly say "blok sehingga sembilan qubit", and [23] should follow that pattern. examples.suggested: semasa instansiasi laluan ... menginstansiasikan

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The optimality claim, the caveat about noise drift in [20], the post-processing-only cost argument and the IC-POVM description all survive intact. In [13], "mitigated expectation values" became "nilai jangkaan ... yang dikurangkan", which literally means the values are reduced. [17] gets this right with "dikurangkan ralat", so [13] should use "yang dimitigasi" or "yang dikurangkan ralatnya". The rest is stiffness: "nilai jangkaan observables yang dikurangkan yang luas" stacks two "yang" clauses, and "turun naik dan hanyut dan" in [20] chains two "dan".

examples.source: give access to a vast set of mitigated expectation values of observables

examples.why: Without 'ralat', 'dikurangkan' says the expectation values themselves were made smaller, not error-mitigated. [17] uses 'dikurangkan ralat' correctly. The double 'yang' is also a calque.

examples.suggested: hingar pada peranti boleh berubah-ubah dan hanyut, jadi hingar yang dipelajari mungkin tidak lagi tepat

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The benchmark claims, the preprocessing steps, the caveat in the Penafian (disclaimer) note and the explanation of Max-k-Cut all match the English. The problems are about wording. "Regular graph" appears as "graf tetap 12-nod" in [45] and as "graf 3-regular" in [48]; "tetap" also means "fixed" on this page (for example "sudut-tetap"), and the usual Malay term is "graf sekata". "Natively enforced/handled" is rendered "secara semula jadi" ("naturally") in [8] and [56], which is weaker than the built-in, constraint-native sense. There is also a calque in [42] ("disediakan oleh hasil"), and "sewenang-wenang" in [35] reads stiffly.

examples.suggested: boleh dikuatkuasakan secara asli (natively) dengan menggunakan XY-mixers

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through. The N-local, data-encoding, quantum-volume and ripple-carry adder passages all match the English, with no dropped caveats and nothing added. In [24], "basis state" and "basis encoding" become "keadaan asas" and "pengekodan asas". In Malay physics, "keadaan asas" usually means the ground state and "asas" also means "basic", so "keadaan basis" or "pengekodan basis" would be clearer. The other problems are small. [10] "senarai qubit untuk menggunakan gate tersebut" reads as "qubits to use the gate", which reverses the roles. The authorial "we" is "kita" in [25] and "kami" in [29]. "kesetiaan arahan" and "tembakan" are literal renderings.

examples.source: Basis encoding, which encodes an integer $k$ by preparing the corresponding basis state $|k\rangle$.
examples.translation: Pengekodan asas, yang mengekod integer $k$ dengan menyediakan keadaan asas yang sepadan $|k\rangle$.
examples.suggested: Pengekodan basis, yang mengekod integer $k$ dengan menyediakan keadaan basis yang sepadan $|k\rangle$.
examples.why: Readers can take 'keadaan asas' as ground state and 'pengekodan asas' as 'basic encoding'. The same term also appears in the amplitude-encoding bullet.

examples.suggested: argumen seterusnya ialah senarai qubit yang akan dikenakan gate tersebut

examples.source: the QAOA algorithm we use for optimization problems
examples.translation: algoritma QAOA yang kami gunakan untuk masalah pengoptimuman
examples.suggested: algoritma QAOA yang kita gunakan untuk masalah pengoptimuman
examples.why: The authorial 'we' is inclusive 'kita' in [25] and exclusive 'kami' here. Inclusive 'kita' suits the teaching voice better.

examples.source: instruction fidelity
examples.translation: kesetiaan arahan
examples.suggested: fideliti arahan
examples.why: 'Kesetiaan' literally means loyalty. Malay technical writing usually uses 'fideliti' for gate or instruction fidelity.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally, and every claim carries over intact: optimization_level 0 is the lowest and 3 the highest, "optimization_level=3 + dd" comes out even closer to the ideal distribution, and fidelity is higher-is-better with 1 as perfect ("kesetiaan Hellinger"). Terms are used the same way throughout: dynamical decoupling is "penyahgandingan dinamikal", decohere is "menyahkoheren", and the ideal distribution is "taburan ideal".

The translation is faithful throughout. The activation caveats, the "do not enter credit card details" warning, the note that a new account is needed even if you already have a personal IBM Cloud account, and the instance-prefix example (physics-101-john-doe) all keep their original meaning. The one flaw is that "28-day rolling window" is translated two ways: "tempoh bergilir 28 hari" in [3] and the literal calque "tetingkap bergolek 28 hari" in [35]. Both should use the more natural "tempoh bergilir 28 hari".

examples.translation: Setiap instans menyediakan sehingga 10 minit penggunaan QPU setiap tetingkap bergolek 28 hari.
examples.suggested: Setiap instans menyediakan sehingga 10 minit penggunaan QPU bagi setiap tempoh bergilir 28 hari.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout, including the role logic in [18]-[20] (`writer` can run jobs but can't list instances, and listing needs `viewer`) and the Reader/Writer/Manager hierarchy in [25]. None of it would mislead a learner. Three small wording problems remain. In [24], "credentials" is rendered as bare "kelayakan", which in Malay means qualifications or eligibility; the standard IT term is "bukti kelayakan". In [17], "perkhidmatan sentiasa Quantum Compute" has no copula and reads as a calque. In [22], the Manager role is rendered as "peranan Pengurus", but on the English UI page the reader is told to visit, the role is labelled "Manager".

examples.source: View instances and credentials / manage credentials
examples.translation: Lihat instans dan kelayakan / urus kelayakan
examples.suggested: Lihat instans dan bukti kelayakan / urus bukti kelayakan
examples.why: Bare 'kelayakan' means qualification or eligibility. For access credentials the conventional Malay IT term is 'bukti kelayakan'.

examples.source: In the context of these guides, the service is always Quantum Compute.
examples.translation: Dalam konteks panduan-panduan ini, perkhidmatan sentiasa Quantum Compute.
examples.suggested: Dalam konteks panduan ini, perkhidmatan yang dimaksudkan sentiasa Quantum Compute.

examples.source: clicking the number by the Manager role

examples.suggested: mengklik nombor di sebelah peranan Manager (Pengurus)

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. The core terms are consistent: qubit, litar, boleh cerap, tembakan, persamaan pembezaan separa, tegasan/terikan. A native editor would still change a few things. [38] "statistik pelbagai jalankan fungsi kami" is ungrammatical because it uses the verb "jalankan" where the noun "larian" is needed. [27] "hujung satunya" is ambiguous for "its other extremity" and also drops the source's bold emphasis. [16] "allow the system to relax" is rendered as "mencapai keseimbangan" (reach equilibrium), which is slightly more specific than the English. [12] "menindih 10 litar" is an odd verb for "stacking" circuits.

examples.source: The following table presents statistics on various runs of our function.
examples.translation: Jadual berikut memaparkan statistik pelbagai jalankan fungsi kami.
examples.suggested: Jadual berikut memaparkan statistik daripada pelbagai larian fungsi kami.
examples.why: The verb 'jalankan' is used where a noun is needed, so the sentence is ungrammatical.

examples.translation: sebatang rod yang ditetapkan dalam ruang ditarik pada hujung satunya
examples.suggested: sebatang rod yang satu hujungnya dipegang tetap ditarik pada hujung yang satu lagi
examples.why: 'hujung satunya' can be read as 'one end' rather than 'the other end'. 'ditetapkan dalam ruang' is also a calque. The bold on the key phrase was dropped.

examples.source: you can select the initial condition and then allow the system to relax
examples.translation: anda boleh memilih syarat awal dan kemudian membenarkan sistem mencapai keseimbangan
examples.suggested: anda boleh memilih syarat awal dan kemudian membiarkan sistem berkembang/mengendur
examples.why: 'Relax' means letting the system evolve. 'Reach equilibrium' is slightly more specific than the English, though not badly misleading.

examples.source: By stacking 10 identical circuits
examples.translation: Dengan menindih 10 litar yang sama
examples.suggested: Dengan menyusun 10 litar yang sama secara bertindan
examples.why: 'menindih' (to press or lie on top of) is an odd word for placing copies of a circuit side by side on different qubits.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The condition logic (control/target in [229], reduced-purity range in [147], Toffoli caveats in [271]/[275]) is faithful, so nothing here would mislead a learner. The problem is terminology consistency, which splits partway through the page. The first half uses "kuantum", "unitari", "Gambaran visual", "tembakan", "benih" and "kerawakan". From about [119] on, the page switches to "quantum", "uniter" ([183], [229]), "Visualisasi", "shot" and "seed"/"rawak", so the link text "Gambaran visual" in [26]/[102] no longer matches the heading "Visualisasi" in [119]. The UI mode is also split between "mod semak" ([22], [95]) and "mod Inspect" ([97]–[103]), and barrier appears as both "penghalang" ([76]) and "halangan" ([234]).

examples.suggested: bagaimana litar kuantum mempengaruhi keadaan sekumpulan qubit
examples.why: The first half of the file uses the standard Malay spelling 'kuantum' ([5], [58]) and 'litar'. From [119] on the page switches to the English spelling 'quantum', so the two halves of one page read inconsistently.

examples.translation: simulator statevector satu shot ... berdasarkan *seed*
examples.suggested: simulator statevector satu tembakan ... berdasarkan *benih*

examples.source: All unitary circuits can be decomposed
examples.translation: Semua litar uniter boleh didekomposisikan
examples.suggested: Semua litar unitari boleh diuraikan
examples.why: 'unitary' is 'unitari' in [16], [51], [86] and [90] but 'uniter' here and in [221]/[229]. 'didekomposisikan' is also a stiff calque; 'diuraikan' is more natural.

examples.source: Visualizations
examples.translation: Visualisasi
examples.suggested: Gambaran visual
examples.why: Earlier sections render the term as 'Gambaran visual', including the link text in [26] and [102] that points to this heading. Using 'Visualisasi' here breaks that correspondence.

examples.source: It applies a NOT to the target only when both controls are in state |1>
examples.translation: Ia menggunakan NOT kepada sasaran hanya apabila...
examples.suggested: Ia mengenakan NOT pada sasaran hanya apabila...

examples.source: Sign in and click **Run circuit** to get results from the specified backend instead.
examples.translation: Log masuk dan klik **Run circuit** untuk mendapatkan keputusan daripada Backend yang ditetapkan.
examples.suggested: Log masuk dan klik **Run circuit** untuk mendapatkan keputusan daripada backend yang ditetapkan sebaliknya.

editor_note: The Malay is faithful and natural. It uses "sekatan berasaskan konteks", "polisi pengurusan identiti dan akses (IAM)", "zon rangkaian" and "bukti kelayakan telah terjejas" consistently, and the role conditions in [5] (Administrator to change rules, Editor or Administrator to change network zones, Viewer can only add zones to a rule) match the English exactly.

The meaning is faithful all the way through. The 90%/80% mitigation thresholds, the caveat that the Aer noise model is milder than a real QPU's, and the claim that to_clifford keeps two-qubit gates and depth all come through intact. The issues are terminology. "figure of merit" is rendered as "metrik prestasi" in [24] and then as the calque "angka merit" in [28]. editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The negations and quantities in the ZNE, PEA and PEC sections are correct, including "tidak dijamin menghasilkan keputusan yang tidak berat sebelah", the quadratic-vs-linear accumulation and the 3x overhead. Some wording still needs fixing: in [31] "benchmarking" is rendered as "membandingkan" (comparing), and "measurement twirling" as "pengukuran twirling", which reverses the head noun. In [18] "Performed alone" became "Apabila dilakukan sahaja", which reads oddly. The sampling verb is inconsistent ("mensampling", "menyampling", "disampling" and "pensampelan"). There is also a spelling slip in [29], "pembalikkan" instead of "pembalikan", and in [61] "mengurangkan keputusan" literally says the result is being reduced.

examples.suggested: twirling pengukuran mempunyai kesan mendiagonalkan matriks pemindahan ralat readout

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The stds/ensemble_standard_error explanation, the twirling grouping and the ZNE fit-uncertainty caveat in [26]-[31] all match the English, and I found no drift. editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The remaining issues are editorial: "eigenvector"/"eigenstate" stay in English while "nilai eigen" is translated, where "vektor eigen"/"keadaan eigen" would be consistent. editor_note: The meaning holds throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. The Trotter decomposition, the 2n+1-node and 41-qubit chain, the edge-colouring rationale and the Fire Opal and MPS comparison all match the source, and "observable→boleh cerap" and "shots→tembakan" are used the same way each time. Two terms would still get an editor's attention. First, "fidelity" and "accuracy" are both rendered as "ketepatan" ([7], [47]). In [47] that leaves the MPS bond-dimension "accuracy" and the "high fidelity" of the result as the same word, so a distinction the source makes is lost. Second, "entangling two-qubit interactions" becomes the unusual coinage "menjalin kusutan" ([7]), where a conventional term such as "menjerat/keterjeratan" would read more naturally.

editor_note: The meaning is accurate all the way through, and nothing in the page would mislead a learner.
